parent.behavior_scope: accepted local stockout and backorder with explicit REMOVE and REPLACE

supporting_prerequisite.behavior_scope: accepted explicit stations at separate bases

source.source_boundary: A local stockout creates a backorder. General StationStructure links a supported station STID to mother MSTID. With FAST ordering, demand reaches the support station immediately; TFRMS is downward time from mother to child and TTOMS is upward time for a faulty item. A repaired item first serves any backorder at its station, otherwise enters local stock.

delta.mechanism: Add DEPOT-01 as BASE-01's sole general upstream support station, FAST demand propagation, 2h downward and upward transport. Keep base stock zero, add one depot spare, and locate the inherited one-hour direct LRU repair at the depot so local repair cannot satisfy the shortage before the shipment.

predeclared_native_acceptance: The frozen seed/configuration must produce at least one installed-LRU failure and local system SURP demand. Exact stochastic times come from native events.

The base starts with zero stock and demand creates a local backorder. Under FAST ordering, the depot issues its sole opening spare before the faulty item arrives there; downward transport of that physical spare lasts two hours.

Trace the upstream issue, in-transit item identity, arrival at BASE-01, backorder clearance, actual REPLACE fit and aircraft readiness. Separately trace REMOVE, upward faulty-item transport, depot arrival, one-hour direct ItemRepair and terminal depot stock. Reconcile both station inventories and all observed demands without duplicate issue.
Import/export must preserve every row-containing source table, including all-null placeholders; conversion errors must be zero, four native CLI steps must succeed, and sealed raw hashes must close.

Reconcile mission outcomes, failure/repair and backorder measures with 72 half-hour system and stock intervals, and terminal ready/stock/backorder/in-transit state. Trace any additional observed cycles rather than stopping at the first event.
Use session-0 SSH under the host-wide native queue, preserve GUI PID 13340 and obtain independent prelaunch and read-only native replay.
limits: This is one general support link, one upstream spare, FAST ordering and fixed two-hour transport in both directions. SLOW, upstream shortage, zero-time transport, end-horizon in-transit stock, lateral support, reorder, resource contention and PM remain unverified.
The general StationStructure link is tested here; item-specific overrides are outside scope.
Exact failure time is run-specific; the native event log, not the input seed alone, supplies timing evidence.
